title: Bayesian methods and Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms for curve reconstruction and point cloud data analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.26490v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Point-cloud data routinely captured by modern imaging and sensor technologies provide detailed geometric descriptions of objects and environments, but their analysis is hindered by large data volumes, localization noise, and missing information. In addition, existing point-cloud reconstruction pipelines typically return a single best-fit structure without uncertainty quantification. We introduce a fully Bayesian framework for representing point-cloud data and reconstructing closed curves, in which observed points are modeled as noisy perturbations of latent locations constrained to lie on the underlying curve that is regularized by a non-parametric prior. Posterior inference in our framework is carried out using a series of Markov chain Monte Carlo samplers tailored to point-cloud characteristics. Numerical experiments, including synthetic examples and real-world LiDAR datasets, show accurate reconstructions and quantified uncertainty ov

translated_title: 贝叶斯方法与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法在曲线重建和点云数据分析中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26490v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代成像和传感器技术常规捕获的点云数据提供了物体和环境的详细几何描述，但其分析受到数据量大、定位噪声和缺失信息的阻碍。此外，现有的点云重建流程通常返回单一的最佳拟合结构，而不进行不确定性量化。我们引入了一个完全贝叶斯框架，用于表示点云数据和重建闭合曲线，其中观测点被建模为潜在位置的噪声扰动，这些潜在位置受限于底层曲线，并通过非参数先验进行正则化。我们框架中的后验推断使用一系列针对点云特性定制的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样器进行。数值实验，包括合成示例和真实世界的LiDAR数据集，显示了准确的重建和量化的不确定性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种完全贝叶斯框架，用于点云数据的闭合曲线重建，并通过定制马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样器实现了不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fully Bayesian framework for closed curve reconstruction from point-cloud data, with tailored Markov chain Monte Carlo samplers enabling uncertainty quantification.
